statusOverview.actionsInstallation: The basic example uses Button for Replay and Simulate incident; install it together with StatusOverview.
statusOverview.basicBody: Fixed example data: 48 days from Aug 21 to Oct 7, with degraded API performance on Aug 29 and an operational Website. Replay animates the bars; Simulate incident toggles degraded API periods on Oct 5 and Oct 7, with an outage on Oct 6.
statusOverview.incidentAnnouncement: Simulated API incident from Oct 5 to Oct 7.
statusOverview.activityAria: Gateway service activity over the last 60 minutes
statusOverview.activityBody: The activity variant places the label, fixed-width ticks and summary in one row, moving the rail below on narrow containers. Each tick retains its full hit area and keyboard support. Full-height gray ticks indicate idle or empty buckets; shorter ticks indicate unknown status. Supply precise meanings through ariaLabel / tooltip.
statusOverview.p8: card is the default framed status card and chart is frameless. Both use evenly distributed rounded bars, 2 px gaps, an active outline and a surface tooltip. activity is a compact service row. Chart entry animations respect reduced motion.
statusOverview.p9: Optional activity-row controls or results replacing the summary column. Inline in wide containers and stacked in narrow ones. Ignored in card and chart modes.
statusOverview.title: Status bar chart
statusOverview.description: Equal-width status bars for service history or current node snapshots, with Chart color tokens, shared tooltips and keyboard inspection.
statusOverview.implementation: Install status-overview and import StatusOverview to use StatusBarChart. These examples use the existing component that also powers status rails in current Blocks and Pages.
statusOverview.chartMeaning: Each bar represents an equal-duration period or one node. Color indicates status; height does not encode request counts or other numeric values. Use the timeline for history and the node snapshot to compare current states.
statusOverview.dataBoundaryBody: Timeline items represent equal-duration contiguous buckets in one start-to-end range. Normalize irregular samples and calculate availability in the consuming feature before rendering.
statusOverview.keyboard: Focus the rail once, then use Arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up, and Page Down to inspect segments. Escape closes the shared tooltip.
statusOverview.errorMessage: Could not load service status history.
statusOverview.p0: Accessible name for the complete status region and its single keyboard rail.
statusOverview.p1: Primary label displayed at the upper left. In activity mode, pass null and omit rangeLabel to let the rail fill the first row, with results below.
statusOverview.p2: Optional time-range or supporting label beside the primary label.
statusOverview.p3: Caller-computed summary label, value, and semantic status tone.
statusOverview.p4: Timeline with a shared epoch range and equal-duration buckets, or an ordered current-node snapshot.
statusOverview.p5: Localized content rendered whenever the active data mode has no items.
statusOverview.p6: Controls data availability and loading presentation.
statusOverview.p7: Required localized explanation for stale, unavailable, and error states.
statusOverview.p10: Per-status color overrides in chart mode. Defaults: operational var(--chart-1), degraded var(--chart-2), down var(--chart-3), maintenance var(--chart-4), and neutral unknown. Supports partial overrides, such as setting operational to var(--chart-5). Empty buckets retain their neutral texture; card/activity retain semantic status colors.
